data.title: Good News: Trumpet player sings National Anthem after horn malfunction
data.incipit: At Saturday night's Arizona Diamondbacks game, trumpet player Jesse McGuire made an incredible recovery while performing the Star-Spangled Banner after his horn malfunctioned, choosing to finish the song...
data.body: At Saturday night's Arizona Diamondbacks game, trumpet player Jesse McGuire made an incredible recovery while performing the Star-Spangled Banner after his horn malfunctioned, choosing to finish the song while singing. NBC News' Hallie Jackson has the story.
